newsitem.title: USA: Wang says I-NET to improve 1997 results.
newsitem.headline: Wang says I-NET to improve 1997 results.

text.p: Wang Laboratories Inc said on Wednesday it expected its recent acquisition of I-NET Inc to add substantial revenue and enhance its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization in fiscal 1997.

"While we have owned the business for less than two months, we already have contract wins attributable to I-NET which include a $42 million LAN support and Help Desk contract with the U.S. Postal Service and a full-service outsourcing contract with Western Digital worth $15 million," Wang Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Joseph Tucci said.
Because the I-NET acquisition closed on August 29, Wang's fiscal first quarter results include only one month of results from I-Net, Wang said. Its first quarter ended September 30.
I-NET is a Maryland-based network and desktop outsourcing company.
